description: Pins for the Linux tier (scripts/linux/portable-tier.sh): the swift.org macOS toolchain, its Static Linux SDK and the arm64 containers that run the cross-built binary and the XCTest hello tests. Xcode's Swift cannot use the Static Linux SDK, so the tier builds with the swift.org toolchain of the SDK's exact version.

swift.xcodeRelease: Xcode 27.0 (swiftlang-6.4.0.34.1), the Swift release of the Xcode on the development Mac
swift.newerPatchRelease: 6.4.1 (2026-10-12) also has a macOS toolchain and a Static Linux SDK. 6.4.0 is pinned because Xcode ships the same compiler

toolchain.name: swift-6.4.0-RELEASE
toolchain.checksumSource: Computed from the download on 2026-10-22, because swift.org publishes no checksum for the macOS package. pkgutil --check-signature reports Developer ID Installer: Swift Open Source (V9AUD2URP3), notarized.

staticSDK.checksumSource: swift.org install API (https://www.swift.org/api/v1/install/releases.json), verified by swift sdk install --checksum
staticSDK.selectorNote: Select the SDK by id with --swift-sdk <id> --triple <triple>. The bare triple matches every installed Static Linux SDK and SwiftPM refuses it when two are installed.
staticSDK.testFrameworks: none. The SDK ships neither XCTest nor Swift Testing, so no test target can be cross-built for musl.

smoke.note: A glibc image on purpose. A static musl binary that secretly needs the musl loader or the Swift runtime fails here.

xctest.note: The official Swift image of the pinned release. It carries XCTest on glibc, which the Static Linux SDK lacks.

pigz.checksumSource: Computed from the download on 2026-10-22 (lane K3B).
pigz.note: The decompression tests of ExecutorReaderTests need a pigz, which the arm64 Swift container lacks. The tier fetches Ubuntu noble's arm64 pigz 2.8, checks this checksum and unpacks it with dpkg-deb inside each test container, which then runs with LUNGFISH_PIGZ and LUNGFISH_REQUIRE_TOOLS=1. The C0 image carries conda-forge's x86_64 pigz 2.8 at /opt/lge/env/bin/pigz, the decompressor of a CHTC run.
